mapper.select: select 100-sum(ifnull(PRIN_AMT,0)) from FIN_CASH_PLAN where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and MDATE <= str_to_date(#{sysdate},'%Y-%m-%d') group by FINPROD_ID
SELECT CLOSE_PRICE FROM (SELECT * FROM MST_BOND_MARK_INFO_FULL WHERE SEC_ID = #{finprodMarketId} AND VALUE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{sysdate},'%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY VALUE_DATE DESC)TEMP LIMIT 1

SELECT EXERCISE_PRICE FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN WHERE EXERCISE_DATE = ( SELECT MIN(EXERCISE_DATE) FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND EXERCISE_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{sysdate},'%Y-%m-%d') ) AND FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND EXERCISE_TYPE = '02' AND EXERCISE_TYPE = '01'} limit 1
